A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi warrior]] served as the '''Master''' of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Maris Brood]], [[Jedi training/Legends|teaching]] her aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Pilgrim]]''. Stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he and Brood did not fall victim to [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which saw many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|killed]]. [[Force sense/Legends|Feeling]] the deaths of many of his comrades in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Master [[Pilot/Legends|took]] a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and set off to find out what had happened, never to return again.

==Biography==
[[File:MarisBrood-Headshot.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Maris Brood, the Jedi's Padawan]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi warrior]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the Republic's waning days. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was the Master of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Maris Brood]], whom he [[Jedi training/Legends|tutored]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Pilgrim]]''.<ref name="Databank" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> during the closing stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone trooper army]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Jedi and Brood were stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Because of that, they were not affected by [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which dictated that the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]]. However, Brood's Master [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] ripples in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] caused by the deaths of other Jedi. After all of his transmissions to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were met with silence, the Jedi warrior [[Pilot/Legends|took]] his personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and set off to find out what had happened. He discovered that the Jedi Order had been nearly [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and relayed this information to Brood. However, he was not seen or heard from again after that. Seeking revenge, Brood began to search for Vader, but was soon found herself by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Ti took the young Zabrak as her apprentice and spirited her away to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where they sought refuge with the native [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Powers and abilities==
Maris Brood's Master was known as a Jedi warrior, indicating that his talents laid in battle. However, he also had a deep connection to the Force, able to sense the deaths of his Jedi brethren. He was a capable pilot and possessed his own starfighter.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maris Brood's Master was first mentioned in Brood's databank entry in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]], which was released on [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="Databank" /> The same entry, word-for-word, was repeated in the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Guide]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I||Maris Brood}}</ref> and in Maris Brood's entry in the now-defunct [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Brood Databank">{{DB|character|marisbrood|Brood, Maris}}</ref>

According to early drafts of Brood's backstory, her Master was an unorthodox Jedi who roamed the fringes of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], using his power and influence to help those in need, often in ways that conflicted with the Jedi way. During Order 66, he was overwhelmed by the feeling of deaths of so many Jedi and left in search for answers. He never returned, leaving Brood without proper guidance, which resulted in her becoming the leader of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. These elements were ultimately dropped in favor of Brood's current backstory.<ref name="Art and Making">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
